results.name: public-motion/program-seek-100x2
results.description: 100 independent instances of a shared nested two-track three-segment program; arbitrary seeks cross phases; setup excluded

notes.timing: CPU wall-clock only; no GPU submission, device execution or physical-GPU performance measured
notes.work: One immutable nested schedule reused by 100 separately owned Engine instances. Each seek samples both object tracks, selects the active phase and atomically publishes geometry/effects. Seventeen changing times exercise both stages and endpoints. Source matching, compilation, allocation and rendering excluded. One item is one object-track update including its share of selection/publication; not an entire rendered frame.
